scope: read-only verification after completed tests; no media rerun or system mutation

build_affinity.operation: taskset -pc 0,1 630568 applied only to build runner; later worker builds launched with taskset -c 0,1

runtime_affinity.basis: LAN, runtime, runtime-retake and GUI were separate systemd --user transient units launched directly with .local/env.sh python3, without taskset/CPUAffinity/AllowedCPUs; env/dev/spawn do not set affinity; child Hub/worker inherit from runtime parent
runtime_affinity.evidence_boundary: Inference from actual launch records and affinity inheritance; not a saved /proc measurement of historical Hub/worker processes

cpu_runtime_monitor.then_configured: 10 samples below 80% before start; interrupt at 3 samples >80% or one >=95%
cpu_runtime_monitor.policy_note: Historical test condition only; user later revoked forced CPU caps; no persistent restriction or monitor remains
